title: Monotonicity of the tableau base
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $s,t\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $s\le t$. Then the tableau base at time $s$ is at most the tableau base at time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet
